summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) filed a Form 6-K furnishing the notice of its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, deal structure, or strategic action are disclosed. The registrant is the issuer of the notice. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC involved. The AGM covers ordinary shareholder matters.
